reasoning_traces.think:
The Narrative Fog primitive synthesizes causal chains from five domains—biophysical (injury impact), cognitive (presser sentiment), DFS (ownership), market (book lines), and on_field (tracking)—into a unified probabilistic model. Availability shifts introduce uncertainty in snap share and pressure dynamics, modeled as stochastic perturbations in a Bayesian framework. Tracking efficiency provides real-time corrections to player projections, updating priors via empirical drift. Microstructure alignment ensures consistency between independent market anchors, validating or flagging stale beliefs. Dualities emerge in how cognitive signals (e.g., presser sentiment) may be noise or signal depending on timing and context. Failure modes include misalignment of tracking data with historical norms, stale book lines, and over-reliance on public presser sentiment. These elements collectively define a structured epistemic space where each domain contributes to a coherent inference over game outcome likelihood.
